# Case 035: Shower Repair Request

## Case details
- source role: Tenant
- created: 2025-10-12 02:51:06 UTC
- property: Flat 23, 63 Meadow Row, Bellmere, ZZ6 6ZZ

## Initial request
I would like to report an issue with the shower in my property.

The water pressure from the shower has become very low compared to its normal performance. In addition, the shower hose/pipe appears to be loose where it connects to the shower head, and I am concerned that it may be damaged or starting to break.

The low water pressure is affecting normal use of the shower. I would appreciate it if someone could inspect the shower, hose, and connections to determine the cause of the problem and carry out any necessary repairs.

input.message:
Hello, an update on your shower report (low pressure and loose hose) at Flat 23, 63 Meadow Row.

The landlord obtained the parts and arranged the work directly with you (our email of 12 October), and he has since telephoned us to confirm the work has been completed. Before we close the request, please confirm two things:

1. Is the shower now working normally — pressure restored and the hose secure at the shower head?
2. Please press the test button on the smoke alarm(s) in the flat and tell us whether each one sounds. If any alarm does not sound, or you see any sign of water staining near a ceiling alarm, tell us straight away and we will arrange for it to be checked.

If the shower work is not in fact finished, let us know and we will re-open the job with the landlord.
